name: EMT Solar and Roofing
old_description: EMT Solar & Roofing, originally founded in 2018 under the name EMT Renewables, is a leading provider of solar energy and roofing solutions. The company, based in Cherry Hill, NJ, has grown rapidly, now employing over 200 people. EMT is known for its strong commitment to customer satisfaction, maintaining a 4.9-star rating on Google from over 1300 reviews. The acronym EMT stands for Energy Management Team.
about:
EMT Solar & Roofing began in 2018 as EMT Renewables in Cherry Hill, New Jersey. Founder Tom Cleary, drawing on a background in education and technology, established the company to deliver renewable energy solutions designed to last for future generations. The name stands for Energy Management Team.

The firm provides a full suite of solar and roofing services, including solar panel installation, repair, and removal; roof repair, replacement, and re-installation; and gutter, trim, and siding installation. With a workforce of over 200, the company operates across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, and Massachusetts, handling projects from residential rooftops to industrial and commercial arrays.

Customers range from homeowners seeking to cut utility costs to business owners pursuing energy savings and property-value gains. The company cites installations at industrial, commercial, and residential sites throughout its four-state service area.

Cleary's stated mission is to make solar affordable and simple, backed by what the company describes as the best warranties in the business — including a 5-year labor warranty and GAF Master Elite coverage — and a process designed for minimal disruption.
